units.en: As ⟦0⟧, control every state in the world.
NOTE: states need to be controlled directly (puppets don't count.)

This approach can be combined with getting ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. It works because the ⟦4⟧ focus gives you cores in the ⟦5⟧ South and Central America as far as the border between Guatemala and Mexico, as well as the entire Caribbean. If you can manage to seize all your cores, Socialist Brazil (or, rather, ULASR) becomes the fourth largest country in the world by core population (after ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, and ⟦8⟧), and with industrial output that rivals any of the other majors.
Go down the ⟦0⟧ path and win the civil war. Just snake towards ⟦1⟧ and naval invade (send two divisions to Rio, Sao Paulo, and Porto Alegre), and the civil war will be over before you know it.
Choose one of the three mutually exclusive foci to pick a leader. ⟦0⟧ is pretty strong, but you can also go ⟦1⟧ for some extra support foci.

Rush down to ⟦0⟧. Now you can go for the war goals foci. If you want to do Jaguar Diplomacy, make sure you get non-aggression pacts BEFORE going Establish ULASR, as the cores you get will severely harm relations with the UK, France and the like.
If you want to do ⟦0⟧, make sure you get non-aggression pacts BEFORE going ⟦1⟧, as the cores you get will severely harm relations with the ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and the like.

Conquer South America. You can end up at war with Argentina if you declare on Uruguay, so be mindful if you aren't prepared. If you are not in a hurry, use "reorganize the railways" decision to put extra supply hubs next to the borders of Bolivia and Paraguay, in Punta Pora and Guapore (and while you're at it, a third one in Amazonas by the Colombian border, for later use). Paraguay in particular can be very difficult without a supply hub, since it needs to be ground down to 0% VPs and you'll be out of supply once you reach their capital. Don't go overboard building industry, but try to get at least 20 fully equipped 9/1's for the first war. You'll be getting lots of factories and infantry equipment with every conquest. Possible order: Bolivia, Paraguay, Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, then either Colombia or Peru. Start aggressively building dockyards and a large fleet as soon as Chile and Argentina capitulate. You'll need a minimum of 12-15 capital ships and 60-80 well-equipped screens to have a decent chance of naval invasion of the UK. You'll get about half of that (~6 capital ships and a number of destroyers) as spoils of war from Chile and Argentina, the rest you'll have to build yourself (none of the other powers on the continent own capital ships, at best, you'll get a few destroyers and subs from them.) Note that you start with a -40% dockyard construction / -15% dockyard output malus and you need to do the Corrida Armamentista Naval focus to remove it. There's a high risk that someone will join a major faction after you declare on them. The logic there is unclear and it may be random. Anyone who's over 30% Democratic can join the the Allies (this applies to Uruguay, Argentina, and Chile), and anyone who's over 30% Fascist can join the Axis (Peru and Venezuela). Rushing things is supposed to help (they are less likely to join factions if world tension is low; try to do as much conquering as you can before German invasion of Poland.) Jaguar Diplomacy and a non-aggression pact with the UK do not prevent the UK from letting your opponents into the Allies or from being called into a war against you. If your opponent joins the Axis, reroll (possibly after trying for Snakes on a plane and/or And the snake smoked.) If they join the Allies, be prepared for naval invasions into every unprotected port and for a fleet with 10 capital ships to show up and start shredding your navy. It might still work if you bag Argentina and Chile (and make sure to take their navies in peace conference) before you have to fight the UK. Europeans will mostly lose interest in you once you kick them off the continent. Preemptively put some units on the borders of their colonies in South America (Suriname, etc.), and, once you're at war with the UK, naval-invade the four Atlantic islands under Allied control (Falklands, South Georgia, Saint Helena, Ascension).
You can end up at war with ⟦0⟧ if you declare on ⟦1⟧, so be mindful if you aren't prepared.

You'll get about half of that (~6 capital ships and a number of destroyers) as spoils of war from Chile and Argentina, the rest you'll have to build yourself (none of the other powers on the continent own capital ships, at best, you'll get a few destroyers and subs from them.) Note that you start with a -40% dockyard construction / -15% dockyard output malus and you need to do the ⟦0⟧ focus to remove it.

There's a high risk that someone will join a major faction after you declare on them. The logic there is unclear and it may be random. Anyone who's over 30% Democratic can join the the Allies (this applies to Uruguay, Argentina, and Chile), and anyone who's over 30% Fascist can join the Axis (Peru and Venezuela). Rushing things is supposed to help (they are less likely to join factions if world tension is low; try to do as much conquering as you can before German invasion of Poland.) Jaguar Diplomacy and a non-aggression pact with the UK do ⟦0⟧ prevent the UK from letting your opponents into the Allies or from being called into a war against you. If they join the Allies, be prepared for naval invasions into every unprotected port and for a fleet with 10 capital ships to show up and start shredding your navy. It might still work if you bag Argentina and Chile (and make sure to take their navies in peace conference) before you have to fight the UK.

Europeans will mostly lose interest in you once you kick them off the continent. Preemptively put some units on the borders of their colonies in South America (Suriname, etc.), and, once you're at war with the UK, naval-invade the four Atlantic islands under Allied control (Falklands, South Georgia, Saint Helena, Ascension).

Take down the Allies. Ideally, you want to capitulate the UK before the USA joins. That is very difficult, though, because you don't have the navy to naval-invade them, your dockyard construction is crippled, and your ability to build a navy is dependent on steel imports (imports from Europe will be badly impacted by the UK raiding your convoys, the USA will embargo you when you turn Communist, and there's not much steel available in Asia.) And you'd have to really rush things to bag the entire South America before the USA joins the Allies. Alternatively, focus on securing North America first. 48 divisions of 9/2s should do the job. (You'll need more when you get to the USA.) Minor note 1: Once you reach Mexico, you need to push hard and don't stop until you have most of the country. If you pause for regrouping and reinforcement, the USA will send its troops to reinforce the front line, and, instead of steamrolling over the defenders, you'll be stuck for months trying to push back a defensive line across central Mexico manned with 50 U.S. and Mexican divisions and receiving mountain/jungle defense bonuses. Minor note 2: there's no railroad from Colombia to Costa Rica. If you discover your troops 'out of supply' for no apparent reason mid-conquest of the USA, it's because they are being supplied by convoy. Build the railroad. If you're somehow still not at war with the Allies at this point, declare war on them, optionally join Axis, and naval invade the United Kingdom. One way that works reliably (even without the need to join the Axis) is to go across the North Atlantic. With the USA capitulated and their massive steel reserves at your disposal, ramp up naval output, invade Greenland, then Iceland, then Ireland (all three will be lightly protected), then, using Ireland as a staging area for your armies, launch simultaneous naval invasions aimed at several points across the Irish Sea. Once you have full control of their coastline from Liverpool to Glasgow and 48 divisions manning the line, UK's days are numbered. The hardest part will be amassing enough navy to get 50% naval superiority needed for the invasion. Take Nottingham for The Merry Band achievement if you have Lampiao as leader.

One way that works reliably (even without the need to join the Axis) is to go across the North Atlantic. Once the ⟦0⟧ capitulate, you should justify and declare war on ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ one after another. ⟦3⟧ will give you a good staging ground against the ⟦4⟧. If ⟦5⟧ still has not joined the ⟦6⟧, declare and don't call anybody into the war. Take all of Portugal's cores (including islands in the Atlantic!) to get I'm home!.
Take all of ⟦0⟧'s cores (including islands in the Atlantic!) to get ⟦1⟧.

Build up near the ⟦0⟧ border to ⟦1⟧/ ⟦2⟧. Declare with army groups and make sure to escort convoys from your capital to Iberia. Best case scenario the Axis has NOT capitulated the Soviet Union. If they have, it might get very difficult to capitulate the Axis, but not impossible
Best case scenario the ⟦0⟧ has NOT capitulated the ⟦1⟧. If they have, it might get very difficult to capitulate the ⟦2⟧, but not impossible

Leave the ⟦0⟧, join the ⟦1⟧, and join wars against the ⟦2⟧. If you can't join the ⟦3⟧, make sure to not declare on ⟦4⟧ or ⟦5⟧ directly, as they can get ⟦6⟧ to join with a guarantee. If you cap the Axis after puppetting the UK, you'll get the And the snake smoked achievement (but possibly only if you're still in your original faction): despite the description, that achievement fires if you control Berlin while in the same faction as the UK, whichever faction it is.

If you cap the Axis after puppetting the UK, you'll get the ⟦0⟧ achievement (but possibly only if you're still in your original faction): despite the description, that achievement fires if you control Berlin while in the same faction as the UK, whichever faction it is.

Once the ⟦0⟧ capitulates, you will have to capitulate ⟦1⟧ and/or the ⟦2⟧. 9/3s with engineer, artillery, anti air, rangers and signal companies work well against the onslaught. Just have the enemy bash their heads in against your fortified units and then make incremental pushes with the aid of air support, spies, and perhaps some tanks as well. It is recommended to declare on minors while you are at war with a major faction, as they might join the faction and be included in the peace deal once you defeat every major in the faction.

Once all the majors are gone, justify and declare on all remaining countries. ULASR will reign supreme!
